heading: SEBI Orders ₹546 Cr Refund from Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy
tldr: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has ordered Avadhut Sathe and his academy to refund ₹546.17 crore.
This action stems from the academy providing unregistered investment advisory and research services.
An additional ₹67.87 crore in interest has also been levied on the principal amount.
SEBI has imposed penalties totalling ₹11.5 crore on Avadhut Sathe and related entities.
The refund process, along with interest, must be completed within five months as directed by the regulator.
caption:
Here's a heads-up for anyone taking investment advice! India's market regulator, SEBI, has ordered an academy to refund over ₹546 crore because they gave investment advice without proper registration. This shows how important it is to check if your advisor is officially registered and regulated. Always ensure your financial guidance comes from a trusted, legitimate source.
